professionalSummary.text: Platform Engineer with 2.5 years of experience operating message queue clusters in production, including deployment of cluster changes, on-call incident handling, and capacity planning with product teams.
professionalSummary.witness: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name. On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log. Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.

experienceHighlights.text: Deployed cluster changes to three production message queue clusters over 2.5 years, including two broker version upgrades and tiered storage migration, each documented in a change record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Handled production incidents including a partition leader storm (July 2024) and four consumer lag incidents while on the platform on-call rota, all recorded in the platform incident log.
experienceHighlights.witness: On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran capacity changes with owners of six busiest topics, documenting responsibility boundaries in each change record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Change records for two broker upgrades and tiered storage move with staging results, and platform incident log records for July 2024 leader storm and four lag incidents.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the change records for the two broker upgrades and the tiered storage move with their staging results, and the platform incident log records for the July 2024 leader storm and the four lag incidents.

skills.text: Production cluster deployment, incident handling, capacity planning, and documentation of cluster boundaries.
skills.witness: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name. On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log. Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'. Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record. Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.
